description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for resource permissions in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating permissions like read, create, update, and delete, and providing methods to combine and initialize these permissions.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates permissions (read, create, update, delete) for a resource, with methods to combine permissions and create instances from arrays or data group permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ResourcePermission object with specific boolean permissions.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the resource can be read.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the resource can be created.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the resource can be updated.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the resource can be deleted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Combines this permission with another using logical AND, returning a new ResourcePermission.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Combines this permission with another using logical OR, returning a new ResourcePermission.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from an array of permission flags, with an optional default value.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from a DataGroupPermission object.
